name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (2026-07-04) is a major release with 238 commits introducing Connect Knowledge (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox integration), a 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), per-room agent Channels, a Telegram remote-control gateway, and a 'Manila Arc' borderless redesign. Security improvements include PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt and login rate-limiting. v0.6.0 introduces a self-update mechanism, with future releases published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases. Clean-path routing replaced hash routing, and the internal team-chat directory was renamed from `.slack` to `.channels`.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes, with active releases including v0.5.0 on 2026-07-04 and v0.6.0 shortly after
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes, with PBKDF2 password hashing, per-install salt, login rate-limiting, and KB_PASSWORD gate for daemon

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron. Old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser, but the canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from `.slack` to `.channels`, scoped per room.
v0.6.0 moves the update mechanism to a new updater; future releases are published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases rather than the original repository.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet but is significantly heavier to set up and resource-intensive.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a richer document management system with workflow and permissions but is heavier and more complex compared to Cabinet's minimalist approach.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document processing and metadata extraction but requires more infrastructure and configuration than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focuses on file browsing across multiple backends but lacks document-management features like tagging and OCR.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a comprehensive self-hosted cloud platform with file management and document apps but is far heavier and more complex than Cabinet.
